response.rationale: The acute onset of confusion, autonomic symptoms, headache, and prior migraine history strongly support acute confusional migraine. The absence of seizure features (F03) and normal MRI (F12) make epilepsy and TIA less likely. The response to diclofenac (F10) further supports a migrainous origin.
